name: Ruou doac
summary: Rượu đoác is the Chứt drink Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park says is made from the sap of the đoác palm. The same note says starch from that palm, Arenga pinnata, was a staple in hard times.
origin: Chứt communities in the Phong Nha-Ke Bang buffer.
culture: The park counts the drink with cơm pồi and ốc lèn as food tied to daily life, custom, and festivals.
howToEat: It is a drink made from đoác sap. The park does not describe a serving ritual.
The starch from the same palm is a separate sentence, not the drink.

where: Chứt communities in the buffer. A shop address is Check on arrival.
